lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular spots arranged in a series of vertical columns posterior to the gill slits. Centroids are distributed with relatively uniform spacing between adjacent vertical columns on the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal clusters of spots to form a rectilinear grid-like pattern across the primary flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A primary horizontal ridge is visible on the upper third of the flank, characterized by high-intensity pixel values on the dorsal-facing surface transitioning to a sharp shadow gradient on the ventral-facing edge.
